correctness.rationale: For n=p^a the defining equality Phi_f(n)=f(n) is immediate. For mixed prime-power support choose blocks P=p^a,Q=q^b and the comparator g(r)=1. Set f(P)=2,f(Q)=1/2 with all other blocks equal 1; f(n)=g(n) while [Phi_f-Phi_g]/n=1/P-1/(2Q) is nonzero since P=2Q is impossible for powers of distinct primes. Conversely order P>Q, set f(P)=2,f(Q)=1-Q/P: transformed values agree, while products differ since again P cannot equal 2Q. Positive real completely multiplicative extensions exist using positive roots. This proves both directions fail for EVERY mixed-support n≥2. I checked the actual frozen RESULT.md and exact rational finite verifier text; independently verified arithmetic for 2≤n≤10000. Finite checks corroborate, do not prove the universal quantifier.
